title: Every lane the coordinator starts carries a cs-step tag, so the archive pass can see it
why: A lane with no cs-step tag never passes the idle-lanes archive tests: the build cannot tie it to a step. Example: #3052's lane session_013NEJKzMndrATd5V4pyEZoB. The same gap hid lanes from the stale-draft row on Nov 12 (plans/stale-drafts-2026-11-13.md).
note: The coordinator's lane start sets cs-step:<slug> with set_session_tags in the same turn as create_session. Guard: a check at lane start (or in the coordinator brief template) that refuses a create_session for a lane with no cs-step tag. Red test first. Until then, runner 10 archives merged lanes by the session named in each PR footer.
